name: ARGUS
tagline: Decentralised AI-powered surveillance and investigation platform
problem: Investigations need to follow a subject across many camera feeds without sending raw video to a central cloud.
highlights: Owned model research and training for the perception stack: YOLOv8 for object and license-plate detection, ArcFace/InsightFace for face recognition and cross-camera re-identification, with all raw video processed locally.
Built the multi-camera tracking feature that follows a subject continuously across feeds by matching identities between nodes.
Built and trained an audio detection model, extending the pipeline to multi-modal (audio and video) evidence.
Currently exploring Kubernetes to scale the distributed node deployment (learning phase).

name: VeriFarm
tagline: Blockchain-based agricultural supply chain transparency platform
problem: Consumers cannot easily verify the journey of agricultural products from farm to shelf.
highlights: Built the consumer dashboard's QR-code scanning: scanning a product verifies its journey and records the check on the blockchain ledger.
Built a web dashboard for supply-chain visibility.
Took part in research and planning for the platform architecture.
Contributed to backend API design and development.
First Place, Cybersecurity and Blockchain track, ADVAYA 2.0 national-level 24-hour hackathon (BGSCET).

name: SAATHI
tagline: AI voice assistant with respiratory health analysis
problem: Users need a natural, conversational way to ask health questions and get a first signal on respiratory health.
highlights: Designed a core part of the conversational engine: user query understanding and response generation.
Trained respiratory audio analysis models on the Coswara dataset for health-status classification and biological age regression.
Iteratively debugged training pipelines across Colab and Kaggle.

name: AXIOM
tagline: Agentic Payment Protocol (AgPP) for autonomous AI agents
problem: AI agents that pay for API access autonomously need identity, auditability and protection against abuse.
highlights: Designed a 4-layer, 6-smart-contract payment governance protocol on Algorand, going beyond a standard x402 payment wrapper.
Implemented deterministic cryptographic agent identity, on-chain Merkle-tree Intent Documents as auditable reasoning receipts, and an SLA-contingent escrow with automatic refunds.
Built ML defences (semantic route verification and behavioural anomaly detection) across an 11-step payment pipeline.
Developed a Red Team CLI simulating 6 attack vectors to stress-test security before deployment.
Third Prize, Hack.Algo hackathon (GDG on Campus, REVA University) as team CleverFyre.
